title: Joe Venudo and Sperry Karas
summary: Venudo as a star percussionist; Karas set up the German episode.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Joe Venudo became kind of a star in the band, didn't he? He was featured on a lot of different percussion.
Yes, he was a very electric sort of person. I guess he did very well as a percussionist after that.

He's in Reno now. We had Sperry Karas (phonetic spelling), who got drafted into the Seventh Army Symphony, was was instrumental in setting up that German episode. That was an experience, a unique one, but that didn't last very long though.
How did that come about? That was around '55 or something?
